name: The Inn at the Round Barn Farm
notes: Home base, 1661 E Warren Rd, Waitsfield. All drive times measured from here.

name: The Silver Trout (fly shop)
notes: 40 Bridge St, Unit 4 (upstairs), Waitsfield. Fri-Sat 10-4, Sun 10-3, or by appointment 802-496-3110. Flies and current local advice.

name: Blueberry Lake (stocked brook trout)
notes: 48-acre USFS lake on Plunkton Rd, East Warren: stocked brook trout plus largemouth, bluegill, bullhead (report p.8). Swimming, kayaking, easy trail loops. Move the pin onto the lake; the lot is across the road.

name: Roxbury Fish Culture Station
notes: 3696 Roxbury Rd (Rte 12A). Vermont's oldest hatchery (1891), rebuilt after Irene and open to visitors; raises brook and rainbow trout. Sits on Flint Brook / Third Branch of the White River, not the Dog — but Rte 12A north from here follows the upper Dog River, brookies-only above Rte 12A per the report.
